blocks.explanation:
Do tangents ka product 1 saabit karna hai.
Har tangent ko sum ya difference wale formula se kholenge; \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) hone se dono bohat saaf ho jate hain.
Plan: dono ko expand karein, multiply karein, aur cancel hone dein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: \(\tan(45^{\circ} + A)\tan(45^{\circ} - A) = 1\).
Tareeqa:
\[\tan(\alpha \pm \beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha \pm \tan\beta}{1 \mp \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\]
jahan \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Yaad rakhein: upar wahi sign jo angle mein hai, neeche ulta sign.

Pehla factor kholein
\[\tan(45^{\circ} + A) = \dfrac{1 + \tan A}{1 - \tan A}\]
Kyun: Formula se \(\dfrac{\tan 45^{\circ} + \tan A}{1 - \tan 45^{\circ}\tan A}\) aata hai, aur \(\tan 45^{\circ}\) ki jagah 1 rakh diya.

Doosra factor kholein
\[\tan(45^{\circ} - A) = \dfrac{1 - \tan A}{1 + \tan A}\]
Kyun: Difference formula: upar minus, neeche plus. Notice karein ke yeh pehle factor ka bilkul ulta (reciprocal) hai.

Multiply karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1 + \tan A}{1 - \tan A}\cdot\dfrac{1 - \tan A}{1 + \tan A}\]
\[= 1 = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi number ko us ke reciprocal se multiply karein to 1 aata hai. Yahan pehle ka numerator doosre ka denominator hai, is liye sab cancel ho gaya.

Tasdeeq, \(A = 0^{\circ}\) rakh kar
\[\tan 45^{\circ}\tan 45^{\circ} = 1 \times 1 = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ek aasaan angle rakh kar dekha; jawab 1 hi aaya.

blocks.explanation:
Do tangents ka jama zero saabit karna hai.
Dono ko tangent formulas se kholenge; \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\) aur \(\tan\frac{3\pi}{4} = -1\) kaam aayenge.
Plan: expand kar ke dikhana ke doosra fraction pehle ka bilkul negative hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: \(\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right) + \tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{4} + \theta\right) = 0\).
Tareeqa: tangent ke difference aur sum formulas, aur yeh values:
\[\tan\dfrac{\pi}{4} = 1,\quad \tan\dfrac{3\pi}{4} = -1\]
Angles radians mein hain: \(\frac{\pi}{4} = 45^{\circ}\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{4} = 135^{\circ}\).

\(\tan\frac{3\pi}{4}\) ki value
\[\tan\dfrac{3\pi}{4} = \tan\left(\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)\]
\[= -\tan\dfrac{\pi}{4} = -1\]
Kyun: 135 degree quadrant II mein hai, jahan sirf sine (aur cosec) positive hote hain; tangent negative. Allied angle ka rule \(\tan(\pi - t) = -\tan t\) lagaya.

Pehla term kholein
\[\tan\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right) = \dfrac{1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta}\]
Kyun: Difference formula: upar minus, neeche plus, aur \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\).

Doosra term kholein
\[\tan\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{4} + \theta\right) = \dfrac{-1 + \tan\theta}{1 - (-1)\tan\theta}\]
\[= \dfrac{-(1 - \tan\theta)}{1 + \tan\theta}\]
Kyun: Sum formula mein \(\tan\frac{3\pi}{4} = -1\) rakha. Neeche \(1 - (-1)\tan\theta = 1 + \tan\theta\), kyunke minus minus plus hota hai. Upar se minus bahar nikala taake pehle term se mawazna aasaan ho.
Dhyan dein: \(-1\) ko bracket mein rakh kar likhein, warna sign ki ghalti pakki hai.

Jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta} - \dfrac{1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta}\]
\[= 0 = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Doosra fraction pehle ka bilkul negative nikla, aur kisi cheez mein us ka negative jama karein to zero bachta hai.

Tasdeeq, \(\theta = 0\) rakh kar
\[\tan 45^{\circ} + \tan 135^{\circ} = 1 + (-1) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Seedhi values rakh kar bhi zero aaya.

blocks.explanation:
Ek sine of sum aur ek cosine of sum ka jama \(\cos\theta\) saabit karna hai.
Dono ko kholenge aur \(\frac{\pi}{6} = 30^{\circ}\), \(\frac{\pi}{3} = 60^{\circ}\) ki values rakhenge.
Plan: expand, values, phir milte julte (like) terms ikatthe.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: \(\sin\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) + \cos\left(\theta + \frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \cos\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin(A + B)\) aur \(\cos(A + B)\) ke formulas, aur yeh values:
\[\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6} = \cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6} = \sin\dfrac{\pi}{3} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
30 aur 60 complementary angles hain, is liye ek ka sine doosre ka cosine hota hai; yahi is sawal ka raaz hai.

Sine wala term kholein
\[\sin\left(\theta + \dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sin\theta\cos\dfrac{\pi}{6} + \cos\theta\sin\dfrac{\pi}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin\theta + \dfrac{1}{2}\cos\theta\]
Kyun: Sine of a sum ka formula aur upar wali values.

Cosine wala term kholein
\[\cos\left(\theta + \dfrac{\pi}{3}\right) = \cos\theta\cos\dfrac{\pi}{3} - \sin\theta\sin\dfrac{\pi}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\cos\theta - \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin\theta\]
Kyun: Cosine of a sum mein beech mein minus aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Yahi minus \(\sin\theta\) wale terms ko cancel karega; agar plus likh diya to proof kabhi poora nahi hoga.

Dono jama karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin\theta - \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin\theta\]
\[+ \dfrac{1}{2}\cos\theta + \dfrac{1}{2}\cos\theta\]
\[= \cos\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\sin\theta\) wale terms barabar aur ulte sign ke hain, cancel ho gaye. Do aadhe \(\cos\theta\) mil kar ek poora \(\cos\theta\) ban gaye.

Tasdeeq, \(\theta = 0\) rakh kar
\[\sin 30^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2} = 1 = \cos 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides 1 aayin.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan ek fraction hai jis ke andar \(\tan\frac{\theta}{2}\) hai, aur saabit karna hai ke poora fraction \(\tan\frac{\theta}{2}\) ke barabar hai.
Aasaan raasta: tan ko sin/cos mein badlein aur chhoti fractions khatam karein.
Plan: upar neeche \(\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\) se multiply, phir \(\sin(\theta - \frac{\theta}{2})\) aur \(\cos(\theta - \frac{\theta}{2})\) pehchanna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \tan\frac{\theta}{2}\).
Tareeqa: tan ko sin/cos mein likhenge, fractions saaf karenge, phir yeh formulas pehchanenge:
\[\sin(A - B) = \sin A\cos B - \cos A\sin B\]
\[\cos(A - B) = \cos A\cos B + \sin A\sin B\]
jahan \(A = \theta\), \(B = \frac{\theta}{2}\). Jab bhi expression mein tan aur sin/cos mile hue hon, sab ko sin/cos mein le aana aksar raasta khol deta hai.

Tan ko sin/cos mein likhein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sin\theta - \cos\theta\,\dfrac{\sin\frac{\theta}{2}}{\cos\frac{\theta}{2}}}{\cos\theta + \sin\theta\,\dfrac{\sin\frac{\theta}{2}}{\cos\frac{\theta}{2}}}\]
Kyun: \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\). Ab sab kuch sin aur cos mein hai.

Upar neeche \(\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\) se multiply karein
\[= \dfrac{\sin\theta\cos\frac{\theta}{2} - \cos\theta\sin\frac{\theta}{2}}{\cos\theta\cos\frac{\theta}{2} + \sin\theta\sin\frac{\theta}{2}}\]
Kyun: Numerator aur denominator dono ko ek hi cheez se multiply karne se value nahi badalti, lekin andar wali chhoti fraction ka denominator khatam ho jata hai.

Formulas pehchanein
\[\text{Upar} = \sin\left(\theta - \dfrac{\theta}{2}\right) = \sin\dfrac{\theta}{2}\]
\[\text{Neeche} = \cos\left(\theta - \dfrac{\theta}{2}\right) = \cos\dfrac{\theta}{2}\]
Kyun: Upar ka pattern \"sin cos minus cos sin\" bilkul \(\sin(A - B)\) hai, aur neeche ka \"cos cos plus sin sin\" bilkul \(\cos(A - B)\) hai. Aur \(\theta - \frac{\theta}{2} = \frac{\theta}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: Formulas ko ulta pehchanna (expanded shakal dekh kar wapas compact shakal likhna) is unit ki ahem mahaarat hai.

Aakhri qadam
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{\sin\frac{\theta}{2}}{\cos\frac{\theta}{2}} = \tan\dfrac{\theta}{2} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Sine divided by cosine tangent hota hai.

Tasdeeq, \(\theta = 90^{\circ}\) rakh kar
\[\dfrac{1 - 0}{0 + 1\cdot\tan 45^{\circ}} = \dfrac{1}{1} = 1 = \tan 45^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\), \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\); dono sides 1.

blocks.explanation:
Ek side par tangents hain aur doosri par sum aur difference ke cosines.
Right side ko khol kar \(\cos\theta\cos\phi\) se divide karna sab se seedha raasta hai.
Plan: dono cosines expand, phir har term ko \(\cos\theta\cos\phi\) se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: \(\dfrac{1 - \tan\theta\tan\phi}{1 + \tan\theta\tan\phi} = \dfrac{\cos(\theta + \phi)}{\cos(\theta - \phi)}\).
Tareeqa: R.H.S. se shuru karenge, kyunke us ke brackets khul sakte hain:
\[\cos(\theta \pm \phi) = \cos\theta\cos\phi \mp \sin\theta\sin\phi\]

Right side kholein
\[\text{R.H.S.} = \dfrac{\cos\theta\cos\phi - \sin\theta\sin\phi}{\cos\theta\cos\phi + \sin\theta\sin\phi}\]
Kyun: Upar sum ka formula (minus), neeche difference ka formula (plus). Cosine mein sign ulat jata hai.

Upar neeche \(\cos\theta\cos\phi\) se divide karein
\[= \dfrac{1 - \dfrac{\sin\theta\sin\phi}{\cos\theta\cos\phi}}{1 + \dfrac{\sin\theta\sin\phi}{\cos\theta\cos\phi}}\]
Kyun: L.H.S. mein \"1\" aur tangents hain. \(\cos\theta\cos\phi\) se divide karne par pehla term 1 ban jata hai aur doosre mein sin/cos ke jore ban jate hain. Numerator aur denominator dono ko ek hi cheez se divide karne se value nahi badalti.

Tangents mein likhein
\[= \dfrac{1 - \tan\theta\tan\phi}{1 + \tan\theta\tan\phi} = \text{L.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \tan\theta\) aur \(\frac{\sin\phi}{\cos\phi} = \tan\phi\).

Tasdeeq, \(\theta = \phi = 30^{\circ}\) rakh kar
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1 - \frac{1}{3}}{1 + \frac{1}{3}} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\text{R.H.S.} = \dfrac{\cos 60^{\circ}}{\cos 0^{\circ}} = \dfrac{1}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\tan 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), is liye \(\tan^2 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{3}\). Dono sides aadha.
